metadata.title: Metric Correspondences and Low-Rank Deformations for Conformal and \(m\)-Modified Conformal Vector Fields
metadata.abstract: We fix a smooth vector field and a positive parameter $m$, and compare the nondegenerate metrics for which the field is conformal or $m$-modified conformal with the same prescribed smooth factor. Metrics of arbitrary signature are allowed. Passing to inverse metrics gives a linear transport equation and an explicit correspondence on the exact nondegeneracy domains. At a regular point, transverse initial data yield a signature-preserving correspondence of metric germs. For a nowhere-zero field and a Killing background in dimension at least three, every metric satisfying the modified conformal equation and differing from the background by a tensor of rank at most one has factor zero; its inverse-metric difference is $rX\otimes X$ for a unique smooth function $r$. Under a complete flow, such global deformations exist precisely when the field is null for the background and admits a smooth function $\tau$ with $X\tau=1$. An auxiliary field satisfying $[X,Z]=X$ gives a second correspondence under orthogonality assumptions. Finally, for a nowhere-zero complete field, a Killing metric and a zero-factor modified conformal metric have inverse-metric difference of rank at least two whenever that rank is constant. In the rank-two case, the pair determines a unique auxiliary field. Examples distinguish the roles of dimension, completeness, constant rank, the zero-factor condition, and orthogonality.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 共形向量场度量的输运对应
analysis.workSummary: 固定光滑向量场及m>0，作者比较相同规定因子下的共形与m-modified共形非退化度量，允许任意符号。逆度量把方程化为线性输运，在确切非退化域上建立对应，正则点处横截初值给保符号的度量芽。
analysis.breakthrough: 给Killing背景下低秩变形的结构限制，秩一情形涉及rX⊗X及零因子；完备流的全局可行性联系背景null场与Xτ=1。
analysis.limitations: 维数≥3、处处非零、完备性、常秩、零因子及正交条件分别属于不同结果；摘要末段常秩下界与前述秩一存在的确切对象应正文区分，不能直接合成无条件结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。50页PDF完整提取且无短文本页；核对全文披露候选、文首文末及致谢/工具声明相关位置，未发现作者实际使用生成式AI的正向声明。研究主题及数学缩写不据此认定工具使用；未观察到声明不表示确认未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 伪黎曼与共形方程结构有一定分析价值，但较专门。
